notes.title: Update Notes for v1.0.1
notes.content:
This patch brings some accessibility and quality of life improvements, as well as a few bug-fixes:

Improvements:

[list]
[*] Added keybind changing settings for mouse & keyboard
[*] Added auto-attack accessibility option under the Input settings tab
[*] Added a button for sending bug reports on the main menu
[*] Updated some text on scythe artefacts to make their intent more clear
[/list]

Bugfixes:

[list]
[*] Fixed a bug where the player could dash while they were in their dying animation
[*] Fixed some controller inputs not working properly without Steam Input
[/list]

notes.title: Day 0 Patch Notes
notes.content:
A couple of bug fixes:

[list]
[*] Fixed wrong descriptions on 2 artefacts.
[*] Fixed background generation race condition in some specific edge-cases.
[/list]

If you find any more bugs, please report them at paragonoftime.support@pm.me

Thank you!
